violation_type.title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Infant Not in Play Yard with Side Folded Down (26 TAC §747.2311(3))
violation_type.short_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Infant Not in Play Yard with Side Folded Down
violation_type.typical_finding: During the inspection, a play yard was observed with a broken side latch. This was corrected at the inspection when the provider removed the play yard and discarded it.
